Summer brings a punctual fortnight
Respect for the whole team
Smooth Journeys for Every Companion

The Companion Animal Travel Desk at Aurelia Skyways continues to give careful attention to each journey, from the first enquiry to the final handover. Our passenger coordinator guides travellers through the required steps with calm, respectful communication, while the ground team moves carriers with steady care between services. Every arrangement is shaped by the species, temperament, and comfort of the animal, so each companion can travel with dignity and as little stress as possible.

This week, the desk has seen the usual mix of routine checks, clear updates, and thoughtful follow-up, all of which help keep travel plans on track. Staff have shown admirable patience in handling special requests, and travellers have responded well to the practical guidance provided. Such work may seem quiet, yet it supports a confident and reassuring experience for families and pets alike. We thank everyone involved for maintaining a professional standard and for keeping the welfare of each animal at the centre of the service.
